create_TweetEval_for_subset: create a TweetEval dataset instance for a specific subset like emoji or sentiment
run_TweetEval_main: run the main function to generate k-shot data for all tweet_eval subsets
load_TweetEval_dataset: load a tweet_eval HuggingFace dataset by subset name using load_dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits for a tweet_eval subset
